note: Floor, not an equality requirement, measured by the SAME metric the verifier reads: xcresulttool's test-results summary `totalTestCount`, which counts a parameterized test FUNCTION as 1 (not per-iteration). So this number is lower than the IDE's per-iteration count (794 by xcresulttool vs 806 in-IDE as of MIG-001B). Raised 786 → 794 at MIG-001B. New tests raise it; the verifier fails when fewer execute or any test fails. Read from build/TestResults.xcresult — never from console text.
